knowledge.title: About AuraMend Demo Business
knowledge.content: We provide professional consultations and appointments. Our team is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM. Consultations start at $99.

knowledge.title: Services
knowledge.content: We offer consultations, follow-up sessions, and personalized service plans. Visitors can request an appointment by providing their name, email, preferred date and service.
